comment: Migawari puts up a resistance to extremely damaging attacks.
when: (findUsableItem('Toolbag (Ryuno)') and freeInventorySlots() > 1 and useItem(me) and wait(1)) or \
(findUsableItem('Toolbag (Shika)') and freeInventorySlots() > 1 and useItem(me) and wait(1))
commands: log('Casting', spell.name, '(Immunity to severely damaging attacks) on', me.name)
